final_message:
Implementato il DNS interno gerarchico nel laboratorio:

- root interna su `pc2`, con delega IPv6 a `test.`
- primario `test.` su `pc3` e secondario con AXFR su `pc9`
- delega di `services.test.` verso `pc12`
- resolver ricorsivo dual-stack su `pc11`, con root hints interni e senza forwarder
- record A/AAAA/CNAME/MX/SRV/TXT richiesti
- `pc4` e `pc6` configurati esclusivamente verso il resolver corretto per famiglia IP
- Apache avviato su `pc1`, `pc7`, `pc10` per gli endpoint DNS pubblicati

File aggiornati: [pc2.startup](/Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T5/no_skill/r001/lab/pc2.startup), [pc3.startup](/Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T5/no_skill/r001/lab/pc3.startup), [pc9.startup](/Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T5/no_skill/r001/lab/pc9.startup), [pc11.startup](/Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T5/no_skill/r001/lab/pc11.startup), [pc12.startup](/Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T5/no_skill/r001/lab/pc12.startup), [pc4.startup](/Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T5/no_skill/r001/lab/pc4.startup), [pc6.startup](/Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T5/no_skill/r001/lab/pc6.startup), [pc1.startup](/Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T5/no_skill/r001/lab/pc1.startup), [pc7.startup](/Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T5/no_skill/r001/lab/pc7.startup), [pc10.startup](/Users/matthew/Desktop/Tesi-Skill/runs/lab02_star7_mixed/T5/no_skill/r001/lab/pc10.startup).
